name: generic-client
title: ARTIE is to APIs what a browser is to web pages
kicker: Putting them back together · The generic client
html:
ARTIE is to APIs what a browser is to web pages

The clientSpeaks, and is coupled toWorks with
Web browser
one generic client, for every site		 text/html + HTTP
image/jpeg image/png text/css text/javascript image/svg+xml font/woff2		 An online bank · A wiki · A shop · Any site not yet built
ARTIE
one generic client, for every API		 application/hal+json + HEART profile + HTTP
application/schema+json application/problem+json application/yaml		 AWS API Gateway (preview next) · GitHub · GitLab · Any API not yet built

Coupled to: the media type and the protocol. Not coupled to: certificates, pull requests, merge rules, URL layouts, or which acts exist today. Zero domain code.
say: The browser is coupled to HTML and HTTP, and to nothing about any site: not account numbers, not URL layouts, not which buttons exist today. That's why a bank can change its forms tonight and nobody updates their browser. ARTIE is coupled the same way, to one media type, HAL with HEART's schema forms, and HTTP. Zero domain code: no client certificates, no pull requests, no merge rules. Each answer carries its controls. The next slides preview what that looks like on an API you know, AWS API Gateway.
